lanes.expected_output: approval, rollback, no-autonomous-write, and not-proven boundaries

join_packet.conflict_summary: No unresolved lane conflict; projection and boundary lanes preserve read-only operator judgment.

not_proven: Parallel lane evidence proves local release-readiness join only; it does not prove provider truth, semantic truth, production safety, or broad adoption.
